WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    races.name,
    SUM(results.points) as total_points,
    AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points
  FROM race_stats
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT rs.total_points, rs.avg_laps, at.avg_total_points
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN avg_total at
  WHERE rs.total_points > at.avg_total_points
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_points),
  AVG(avg_laps),
  AVG(total_points - avg_total_points)
FROM filtered

assumptions.assumption: "the average laps for the kept race names" means the unweighted average of the per-race average-laps values computed in the grouping step (i.e., AVG of the avg_laps column), not a recomputed overall average from all individual lap times
results.laps (stored as TEXT) can be cast to REAL for numeric aggregation

alternatives.interpretation: "the average laps for the kept race names" could mean the overall average of all individual lap-time values from results belonging to kept race names—a weighted average that may differ from the unweighted average of per-race averages if races have unequal numbers of results
alternatives.sql:
WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    races.name,
    SUM(results.points) as total_points
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points
  FROM race_stats
),
kept_names AS (
  SELECT rs.name, rs.total_points, at.avg_total_points
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN avg_total at
  WHERE rs.total_points > at.avg_total_points
),
sum_kept AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_points) as sum_total FROM kept_names
),
laps_kept AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  WHERE races.name IN (SELECT name FROM kept_names)
),
excess_kept AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points - avg_total_points) as avg_excess
  FROM kept_names
)
SELECT 
  sk.sum_total,
  lk.avg_laps,
  ek.avg_excess
FROM sum_kept sk
CROSS JOIN laps_kept lk
CROSS JOIN excess_kept ek
